svg.title: How he left: Cressona to the Golden Gate, 1936 to January 1942
svg.desc: A map of the lower forty-eight. Marked are Cressona and Pottsville in Schuylkill County; the summer camp at Indiantown Gap; Camp Pendleton in Virginia; Camp Stewart and Savannah in Georgia; Scott Field in Illinois; Pope Field in the Carolinas; Augusta and a one-day errand to Palm Beach; and the troop train west through St. Louis, McCook and Denver to Oakland and the Golden Gate.
svg.text: the regiment moved as a regiment
Cressona to the Golden Gate, 1936 – January 1942
